defs.def: a game played especially in the US by two teams of nine players, using a bat and ball. Each player tries to hit the ball and then run around four bases before the other team can return the ball. 棒球运动

ex.s: When it comes to seeing a game in person, baseball is by far the most popular sport in America.
ex.t: 就现场观赛而言，棒球是迄今为止美国最受欢迎的运动。

ex.s: And for most people, baseball is “America’s game” in a way that football and basketball are not, because it is a special symbol of the American spirit.
ex.t: 对大多数人来说，棒球在某种意义上是“美国的运动”，而足球和篮球不是，因为它象征着美国精神。

ex.s: For one thing, while baseball is a team sport, every player can be a hero or star.
ex.t: 首先，虽然棒球是一项团队运动，但每个球员都能成为英雄或明星。

defs.def: the ball used in this game 棒球

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看他脱下篮球服、换上棒球服时，我看到他丢下了那层不再适合他的外壳，就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

ex.s: 47    They focused on football，basketball and baseball.
ex.t: 47 他们专注于足球、篮球和棒球。

ex.s: Interestingly，this trend isn’t evident in baseball. where additional individual talent keeps improving the team’s performance.
ex.t: 有趣的是，这种趋势在棒球中并不明显，因为在棒球里增加个人天赋会持续提升团队表现。

ex.s: 48      In baseball，the performance of individual players is less dependent on teammates.
ex.t: 48 在棒球中，个人球员的表现较少依赖队友。

ex.s: Hot peanuts are a hit with hungry baseball fans, but the hot dog is the real winner!
ex.t: 热花生是饥饿的棒球迷的热门选择，但热狗才是真正的赢家！

ex.s: In a typical year, more people attend baseball games than football and basketball games combined.
ex.t: 在平常的年份，观看棒球比赛的人数超过足球和篮球比赛人数的总和。

ex.s: This task interdependence distinguishes baseball from football and basketball.
ex.t: 这种任务的相互依赖，把棒球与足球、篮球区分开来。
